tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Induced connection on an identified immersed patch] ↗ def:riemannian-metric

For an identified immersed patch $D$, an ambient affine connection $ abla $, and vector fields $X,Y$, the induced covariant derivative is the tangential projection of the ambient one: \[ D.\operatorname {inducedCov}_{ abla }(X,Y) =D.\operatorname {tangentProj}( abla _XY). \]
